app_name: ADHD Habit Tracker, To Do List
title: Best app to track good habits and daily goals
body: This app offers without a doubt the best combination of clear and user-friendly UI with all the tools that help achieve great progress in your goals. The use of minimal design with different colours, timers and checkboxes is just perfect for me. On the other hand, the statistics and tracker give you the motivation to continue grinding for your goals and ultimately achieve them. Definitely, this is the best app in the iOS store  if you are looking for some help on building good habits and imrpoving your self to become a better person.
author: iDementoor

app_name: ADHD Habit Tracker, To Do List
title: Muy útil
body: No era muy fan de las aplicaciones de registro de hábitos pero esta incorpora algunas novedades muy interesantes. Calcular el tiempo que le dedicas a una tarea o ponerte un objetivo de horas para una actividad (diario, semanal o mensual). Aunque estaría bien poder tener más información de tus estadísticas con la versión gratuita. Si no pagas apenas puedes ver nada.

app_name: ADHD Habit Tracker, To Do List
title: Great app
body:
Really like the design, and the ability to put on dark mode is essential. 

If I could suggest one feature, maybe the possibility of putting tasks into groups. .ie "Learn Spanish" could be the group, and individual tasks existing inside like "reading" "listening" etc.

Brilliant app though, the developer is helping a lot of lives!
